plainTranslation: Composite Jupiter in the 8 House: With Composite Jupiter in the 8th house, you can find it easier to deal with the serious aspects of the relationship, and deal with serious matters together. The darker side to this house can be somewhat muted with Jupiter here, and you can be less prone to struggling over power and control. You can help to transform one another and deal with deeply-held issues that you’d normally keep buried. 60/ ​© The Dark Pixie Astrology
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
